name: print-social-deep-forest-and-honeydew-two-colour-name-post
title: Deep Forest and Honeydew Colour Post
whatItIs: A portrait post split into a deep forest green upper half with pale text 'Deep Forest #004225' and a honeydew mint lower half with green text 'Honeydew #F0FFF0', each hex code in an outlined pill and a social handle strip at the top.
whatItMeans: Each colour is the other's text colour, and the natural names evoke calm and freshness.
techniques: Swap foreground and background between halves

vocabulary.definition: Two colours chosen to work together.
Two areas where foreground and background swap.
An outlined label with a colour code.
